name: Tripboard
description: Plan a trip together: week board, calendar, todo, packing and map.

meta.note: Multiuser trip-planning applet, REBUILT 2026-07-28 after an adversarial review rejected the first cut. Everything lives in ONE `entries` table (kind: trip|member|plan|event|todo|packing|note) plus a `relations` table (trip-root -> item `contains` edges) — the ONLY table names the share pipeline actually syncs, so inviting someone no longer hands them an empty trip. Identity is a per-install `tripboardMemberId` board SETTING (never $playerId, never sign-in identity) picked via a member card; every content row's `author` is stamped `$setting:tripboardMemberId` at creation. No historybar anywhere (multi-writer-unsafe whole-board undo) — Activity is the audit trail; per-row delete still gets a normal Undo toast. Built per _claude/projects/tripboard-spec.md; see MIGRATION.md for what changed and the honest gaps this v1 still doesn't solve.
